NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SyllabusStudy needs microphone access so you can talk to Glo and record classroom lectures.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SyllabusStudy uses speech recognition to understand your questions for Glo and transcribe lecture notes.
NSCameraUsageDescription: SyllabusStudy uses the camera to scan syllabi, homework problems, and textbook diagrams.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SyllabusStudy needs photo library access to upload assignments and class materials.
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This lets us show you more relevant ads when you choose to watch a video for a free extra use.
